name: Shako VM
description: A new Shako VM for this workspace, deleted with it. A copy of your VM orca-base when you have one (its agents stay logged in), else a small VM with Claude Code and Codex. It sleeps when idle.
create: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; shako vm orca --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || shako update >&2; exec shako vm orca create
suspend: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; shako vm orca --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || shako update >&2; exec shako vm orca suspend
resume: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; shako vm orca --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || shako update >&2; exec shako vm orca resume
destroy: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; shako vm orca --help >/dev/null 2>&1 || shako update >&2; exec shako vm orca destroy
